**Company:** Cahaya Golden Systems Sdn. Bhd. (Private limited company, incorporated 2019‑09‑29, currently winding up) operates in the Technology sector in Selangor, providing software development for small‑business accounting. Its share capital is RM2.5m.  

**Director & Shareholder:** Three directors and three shareholders are recorded. The largest shareholder is Director 2, holding 52.17 % of the shares.  

**Financials:** In FY 2024 revenue rose 2.5 % YoY to RM13,006,124, with a gross profit margin of 60.8 % and an operating profit margin of 14.8 %. Free cash flow fell to RM614.7k, while net debt increased to RM2.33m, indicating a shift from earlier positive cash generation.  

**Litigation:** Eight defendant cases are on record, totalling RM6,823,500 in claim amounts. Four cases remain pending, one dismissed, one withdrawn, one judged, and one settled.  

**Review Rating:** 1/5 — Very low review priority; the winding‑up status overrides other considerations, so further vetting is not a priority.
